expectations.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Complex (or notes multiple emergent dimensions)
expectations.evidence: B0/Inputs section: 'Cynefin domain: Complex. Three themes (sharing behaviour, re-engagement, funnel) all sit in the emergent / behavioural-feedback space.'

expectations.text: Review selects Full tier (quarter-long appetite, multiple themes)
expectations.evidence: Inputs: 'Tier: Full — selected because appetite >1 week AND ≥3 implicit dependencies AND the allocation decision itself is a one-way door for the quarter.'

expectations.text: B1 (problem framing) verdict is SUSTAINED or PARTIAL — themes named without measurable outcomes
expectations.evidence: B1: 'Verdict: SUSTAINED. The plan opens with themes (solutions) and rationales as one-line hand-waves... There is no measurable outcome attached to any theme.'

expectations.text: B2 (scope) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one theme has scope-vague concern (no triage record cited)
expectations.evidence: B2 table includes 'No idea-triage record cited for any theme — SUSTAINED' plus five other SUSTAINED scope items.

expectations.text: B3 (assumptions) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one assumption flagged as low-confidence/anecdotal
expectations.evidence: B3: '"Users want a shareable shortlist" (because we keep getting requests) — Confidence 0.5 — anecdote — SUSTAINED' plus four other SUSTAINED assumptions.

expectations.text: B3 includes a numeric confidence score (Gilad Confidence Meter, 0.1–10) on at least one assumption
expectations.evidence: B3 table contains numeric Gilad scores: 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1 across all five assumptions.
Recommendation section: 'REVISE — the plan is solution-first (B1 SUSTAINED), scope-undefined (six B2 SUSTAINED)...'

expectations.text: Review recommends running idea-triage on themes before allocation
expectations.evidence: Conditions item 1: 'Run idea-triage on each of the three themes before allocation is locked.'

expectations.text: At least one bucket has a named falsifying condition (concrete check that would overturn the verdict)
expectations.evidence: B1 falsifying condition: 'Owner produces, for each theme, a Rule-A2 problem statement with a named target metric and target delta within 24 hours.' Plus per-row falsifying conditions throughout B2.
